name: Glance

surfaces.surface_type: main document window, rendered-markdown reading view (find bar active, table context menu open)
failures: #6 measure — welcome paragraph spans ~75-85ch to near window edge, no visible max-width prose rail
#1 grid / #10 UI-contrast — plausible-pass but unverifiable on ~1x downscaled marketing composite
native#9 toolbar pull-down uses colour app-icon glyph, not a borderless monochrome SF Symbol
native#3 table selection is a spreadsheet-style accent-outline range, not the flat inset-rounded list-row fill (context-appropriate)
native#4 sidebar N/A — single-pane window, no source list

tokens.notes: deliberately LARGER than kit 13pt Body — reading-optimized, the core signature
matches kit Dark Blue; sole accent (selection + find + focus)
zoom -/+ morphed pair; icon pull-down; share
spreadsheet range selection, not list-row fill

patterns.key_values: 3 glass groups, ~36pt XL capsule controls, borderless mono symbols except colour pull-down glyph; zoom pair as one morphed container; trailing share
2-col markdown table (Action|Shortcut), bold header w/ subtle elevated fill, column selection via 2px accent outline + ellipsis handle, edits via context menu
native find bar — pill field, magnifier + query + '1 of 9' + up/down chevrons + clear, right-aligned to content width, two-tier match highlighting
context menu — leading SF Symbols, sentence case, destructive 'Delete Column' divider-separated at bottom, ~10-12px radius

signature_moves: 'No editor chrome' single-pane reading surface — no sidebar/inspector; rendered markdown carries the whole UI
Reading-optimized body type ~15-16px, above the macOS 13pt system Body — chrome density traded for reading density
Two-tier find highlight — bright-yellow active match vs dimmed olive others (Von Restorff inside find)
Editor disguised as a viewer — editable cells + full table-column ops hidden behind native context menus/gestures
Friendly minimal mascot icon (light squircle, faint spreadsheet grid, two-bar eyes + smile) adds brand warmth without breaking quiet chrome
defects: Line Length Fatigue (soft) — welcome prose wraps ~75-85ch to near window edge, no max-width reading rail; canon caps ~65-75ch
Toolbar grammar minor deviation — pull-down uses colour app-icon glyph instead of monochrome SF Symbol (systematic/purposeful, logged as deviation not hard defect)

aesthetic.direction: System-native minimal — neo-grotesque-product restraint (dense-calm, single accent) applied to an editorial reading surface, committed to SF Pro + generous leading rather than a custom typographic identity

psychology: Jakob's Law — leans entirely on macOS conventions (find bar, context menus, traffic lights, share) so it feels instantly familiar; innovation is the product (instant .md render), the interface stays conventional
Aesthetic-Usability Effect — generous typography + clean quiet chrome buys the premium/usable halo on first contact
Von Restorff effect — one accent (blue) + one bright-yellow active find match makes the current hit pop against dimmed siblings
Hick's Law / Progressive disclosure — minimal toolbar; editing decisions (table ops) pushed into context menus rather than surfaced as chrome, reducing decision points
Tesler's Law — irreducible editing complexity absorbed into contextual affordances (menus, gestures) instead of pushed onto visible UI
notes: Single marketing-cover composite only (1680x945, ~1x downscale) — NOT a raw screenshot; all pixels (estimated) with wide ranges, ratios more trustworthy than absolutes. Window right+bottom edges bleed off the composite frame: 'no sidebar / single pane' is inferred, not confirmed. Dark mode only; light mode and all other surfaces (settings, empty state, onboarding) unseen. Marketing tagline says 'viewer' but the window evidences a full editor (editable cells, table-column ops) — do not treat the copy as design intent. First app in corpus: nothing promotable; keep at (inferred). Would benefit from a raw @2x screenshot and a light-mode surface to confirm type scale and canvas tokens.
